text: The operational security gap is orchestration at scale

name: Rectangle 4
text: Practical limitations prevent current tools from covering large infrastructures as one connected assessment.
textPreview: Practical limitations prevent current tools from covering large infrastructures as one connected assessment.

name: Rectangle 8
text:
Specialized tools emit isolated outputs.

Humans repeatedly copy, filter, correlate and decide what to run next.

Assets, services, endpoints and evidence are easily disconnected.

text:
Real infrastructures are wider than bounded CTF tasks.

Each new domain, host, port or endpoint creates more work.

Many AI systems are not optimized for continuous, broad reconnaissance coverage.

text:
API cost, rate limits, connectivity and model behavior can interrupt assessments.

Known pentesting steps do not require expensive reasoning every time.

When the model stops, the core workflow should not stop.

text: Trust and control must span the entire workflow
textPreview: Trust and control must span the entire workflow

name: Rectangle 11
text: Use LLM reasoning when available while maintaining a deterministic rule-based mode with no mandatory LLM dependency.
textPreview: Use LLM reasoning when available while maintaining a deterministic rule-based mode with no mandatory LLM dependency.

name: Rectangle 15
text: Enforce the authorized scope, validate findings with evidence and require human approval before potentially impactful actions.
textPreview: Enforce the authorized scope, validate findings with evidence and require human approval before potentially impactful actions.

name: Rectangle 17
text: The proposed framework combines one unified harness, reliable non-LLM operation and controlled AI assistance.
textPreview: The proposed framework combines one unified harness, reliable non-LLM operation and controlled AI assistance.

name: Rectangle 8
text: Collect signals from tools, targets and prior evidence.
textPreview: Collect signals from tools, targets and prior evidence.

name: Rectangle 13
text: Preserve assets, observations, relationships and source evidence.
textPreview: Preserve assets, observations, relationships and source evidence.

name: Rectangle 18
text: Explain what the evidence may mean and what could be vulnerable.
textPreview: Explain what the evidence may mean and what could be vulnerable.

name: Rectangle 23
text: Choose the next useful probe and run the appropriate security tool.
textPreview: Choose the next useful probe and run the appropriate security tool.

name: Rectangle 28
text: Compare outcomes, reproduce the result and separate a lead from verified evidence.
textPreview: Compare outcomes, reproduce the result and separate a lead from verified evidence.

name: Rectangle 33
text: Record what changed, connect the evidence and revise what should be tested next.
textPreview: Record what changed, connect the evidence and revise what should be tested next.

name: Rectangle 37

textPreview: Updated memory changes what the tester observes and tests next.

name: Rectangle 39
text: The assessment is a continuous evidence loop—not a one-time scanner run.
textPreview: The assessment is a continuous evidence loop—not a one-time scanner run.

name: Rectangle 1
text: Specialized agents for each testing phase
textPreview: Specialized agents for each testing phase

name: Rectangle 4
text: Standard pentest methodology is divided among specialized agents.
textPreview: Standard pentest methodology is divided among specialized agents.

name: Rectangle 10
text: Maps the attack surface using discovery, DNS, probing and service-enumeration tools.
textPreview: Maps the attack surface using discovery, DNS, probing and service-enumeration tools.

name: Rectangle 14
text: Tests the mapped surface with network, web and vulnerability-analysis tools.
textPreview: Tests the mapped surface with network, web and vulnerability-analysis tools.

name: Rectangle 18
text: Confirms evidence and separates reproducible findings from scanner leads.
textPreview: Confirms evidence and separates reproducible findings from scanner leads.

name: Rectangle 19
text: Each agent has its own tools and skill files, but all agents operate on the same shared memory.
textPreview: Each agent has its own tools and skill files, but all agents operate on the same shared memory.

name: Rectangle 9
text: The battle-tested pentesting methodology runs through repeatable rules and tools without requiring an LLM.
textPreview: The battle-tested pentesting methodology runs through repeatable rules and tools without requiring an LLM.

name: Rectangle 13

textPreview: The LLM oversees the assessment, performs contextual analysis and decides where deeper reasoning is useful.

textPreview: Execution environment for Nmap, Nuclei, SQLmap and other security tools.

textPreview: Typed contract connecting the harness with each security tool.
